interpretation: Precision, recall and F1 measure agreement on these local matching keys only. They do not establish scientific validity.

scoring.eligible: Canonical extracted rows from included publications within the gold PDF set.
scoring.table_only: Eligible rows with a nonempty table locator.
scoring.source: Exact normalized raw value, raw unit, metric, cutoff, variant, aggregation, page and table/figure keys.
scoring.context: Source key plus publication-local configuration and dataset field keys, with the same denominators.
scoring.macro: Arithmetic mean across papers with eligible gold rows in each scope, using zero precision for papers with no eligible candidate rows.
